CARDINAL.definition: Numbers that are not quantities, dates, times, money, percentages, or ordinals.

DATE.definition: Absolute or relative calendar dates, including years, months, days, and date ranges.

EVENT.definition: Named or commonly identified events, competitions, wars, and natural events.

FAC.definition: Human-made facilities, buildings, airports, highways, bridges, and other infrastructure.

GPE.definition: Countries, cities, states, and political or geographical entities with governing functions.

LANGUAGE.definition: Named natural languages and language varieties.

LAW.definition: Named legal documents, statutes, treaties, and legal codes.

LOC.definition: Geographical locations that are not GPEs, including mountains, bodies of water, and regions.

MONEY.definition: Monetary values, currencies, and amounts of money.

NORP.definition: Nationalities, religious groups, and political or social groups.

ORG.definition: Named organizations, companies, agencies, institutions, teams, and media outlets.

PERSON.definition: Names of individual people and named fictional characters.

PRODUCT.definition: Named products, objects, vehicles, foods, and commercial goods.

QUANTITY.definition: Measured quantities with units, excluding money, percentages, dates, and times.

TIME.definition: Times of day and durations shorter than a day when expressed as temporal references.

WORK_OF_ART.definition: Titles of artistic, literary, musical, television, film, and other creative works.
